criteria.criterion: >=10 cases (>=5 sections x 2 wave conditions), each with gamma_s M_sw + gamma_w M_wv, M_u, utilisation and PASS/FAIL
gamma_s / gamma_w taken from the CSR table with a clause citation per factor
criteria.detail: BLOCKED: no authorised CSR text in this environment (network 403, no corpus copy). Utilisation is reported at unit factors plus the admissible factor gamma* = M_u/(M_sw+M_wv) and a gamma_w sensitivity scan, so no rule factor value is invented.

criteria.criterion: grid convergence: GCI of M_u < 5% on three grids, order reported
elastic vs Smith ultimate moment listed per case; every case with |difference| > 15% attributed

limitations: plane sections remain plane: no shear lag, torsion, warping or fracture
scantlings are a parametric CSR-consistent reconstruction; the station taper is a declared study assumption, not a rule requirement
a single loading condition (homogeneous loaded tanker) supplies M_sw; it is sagging at midships, so the hogging still-water component vanishes there
CSR partial safety factors gamma_s / gamma_w could not be transcribed; utilisation is a unit-factor reference value, not a compliance statement
the CSR longitudinal distribution factor of M_wv is not transcribed; the station-wise M_wv comes from the design-wave load model instead

pairing_audit.defect: W22 used analyse_direction(condition='sagging') for the one with kappa > 0, i.e. bottom compression, which is hogging; its docstring calls this 'sagging'. The sagging wave moment was therefore divided by the bottom-compression capacity.
pairing_audit.reference: src/tensorfem/hull_girder_smith_collapse.py: 'kappa > 0 ... the bottom is compressed'; src/tensorfem/hull_girder_csr_w22.py analyse_direction docstring
